name: tomar-murgi-store
description: Tomar Murgi Store (তোমার মুরগি স্টোর) — Production Poultry Retail & Commercial B2B Web Platform

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(!fs.existsSync('dist')) fs.mkdirSync('dist',{recursive:true}); fs.copyFileSync('index.html','dist/index.html'); fs.copyFileSync('style.css','dist/style.css'); fs.copyFileSync('app.js','dist/app.js'); if(fs.existsSync('_redirects')) fs.copyFileSync('_redirects','dist/_redirects'); console.log('Static build successfully generated to dist directory');"

author: Tomar Murgi Store
